deck: Nifty closed at 25,893 (▲ 0.29%) and Sensex at 84,297 (▲ 0.43%). Over the last five sessions Nifty is up 2.6%. Brent crude is near $90 a barrel and the rupee at 92.47 to the dollar.
story: Of the 80 large stocks this page tracks, 36 rose and 44 fell. HCLTECH led the gainers (+6.20%), while DABUR fell the most (-2.90%). Bank Nifty ended ▼ 0.21%.
Across markets: Brent crude near $90 a barrel (-2.3% on the week), the rupee at 92.47 per dollar (stronger on the week), gold near $3,599 an ounce.

In the headlines: “Sensex Today, November 26: Sensex Gains 200 Points, Nifty Holds Above 25,850; IT and Metal Stocks Lead Market” (theopenpress.in). “Middle East latest: Explosion reported near tanker off UAE coast, UKMTO says” (The National).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 2.3% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 92.47 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
